description: This file initializes the React application by rendering the main App component into the DOM element with id 'root'. It sets up the rendering root and wraps the App component within React.StrictMode for highlighting potential issues.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering React components into a DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React element into the created root.
